info.description: DRAFT of issue #85 (docs/CONSOLE.md). Local only: a unix socket (role local) or 127.0.0.1 (role console, bearer token). Never public.

servers.description: loopback only; from elsewhere through an SSH tunnel

504.description: the engine did not answer in time

post.summary: run a registry verb as a job. A verb with a confirmation answers 200 with a plan and a single-use token first; the same call again with that token (and, for type:*, the typed text) starts the job.

400.description: bad args (unknown key, wrong type, a name that does not match)

403.description: the role may not run this verb or these args

409.description: busy: 4 jobs already wait; or the plan changed since it was shown

410.description: the confirm token is wrong, expired (60 s) or used

Status.description: admission.py status --json without its requests list (GET /requests has them), plus last_tick read from admission/last-tick

ready.description: the Node's Ready condition; absent = no Node of that name (the CLI prints no)

Event.description: one line of admission/events.jsonl as written (identities blanked after the retention)

args.description: exactly the verb's params (x-actions); any other key is a 400

confirm.description: the token of the plan, single use, 60 s

typed.description: for type:name the name, for type:all the word all

will.description: what it will do, in sentences, from pure reads (panic: the leases it expels)

error.description: plan-changed (exit 75), timeout (exit 124), engine (127), audit (ran, but its audit line was not written), internal or null

exit.description: the engine's own exit code; 124 after the timeout killed the process group

output.description: stdout and stderr together, in the order they came, at most 64 KiB; redacted except for the local role (#85)

stdout.description: the engine's stdout alone, at most 64 KiB; redacted except for the local role (the CLI prints it on its stdout, #88)

stderr.description: the engine's stderr alone, at most 64 KiB; redacted except for the local role

verb.description: a registry verb, or init or down (never through the API)

command.description: what a person types on the host

bearer.description: role console: 32 random bytes, base64url; `mesh host console url` prints it in a link fragment

x-actions.summary: put someone on the waiting list
take a request off the list
approve the named request or the first eligible one; trust friends (the persistent CA) is local only
one tick now, the same as the timer's
auto off, slots 0, every active lease expelled
burn the join token of every registered player, refresh the node guard
token, cordon, drain, revoke, machine, namespace
blocklist the certificate everywhere, delete the node
open the parties both sides agreed to, close the rest
end a party: both consents and its NetworkPolicies removed
a bundle for one player, outside the queue
rewrite and apply a machine's Nebula config
pack the approved bundle into the outbox again
